notes.title: LA COPS Update 2 - CO-OP! CONTEXT COMMANDS! TWEAKS!
notes.content:
[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/517133380407365020/FE2AB2B35F2C856814A1D6144806880DA75E4013/]

COPS,

Those streets are getting nastier every day. It's time to give you more tools to do the job with. Here's the lo-down on today's update:

[h1]CO-OP MODE[/h1]
You can now play local co-op! 

When enabled, co-op mode allows each player to choose a cop and control them exclusively. All you need to get started is an extra Xbox 360 controller or mouse and keyboard.


[h1]CONTEXT COMMANDS[/h1]
We've added context sensitive commands to the game, enabling you to wrangle more control over your AI partner. Hover over an object to see the available commands including:

- Make an arrest
- Destroy that door
- Kill

[h1]OTHER TWEAKS[/h1]
We've thrown in a few extra gameplay tweaks too!

o	Added Enemy AI reaction animations
o	Objectives window toggle
o	Camera Zoom Out increased (helpful for co-op mode!)
o	Added 16:10 rendering option for PC

Get back on those streets cops, and take your buddies with you.

MT17 & Modern Dream

notes.title: LA Cops Update 1 - Tweaks! Free Soundtrack!
notes.content:
[b]COPS,[/b]

[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CAkAXChUMAEAgdV.jpg]

The first update for LA Cops is available now, packing tweaks and changes to AI based on community feedback. Here's what to expect when you next take to the criminal-ridden streets of LA:

[list]
[*]Friendly AI reaction time significantly increased
[*]Friendly AI run speed increased
[*]Player overall run speed increased significantly
[*]Player overall health increased
[*]Slowed the enemies down slightly to avoid the zombie attack effect 
[*]Updated player mini-map icon to white and a black cross is shown when player is dead
[*]Lvl 3 sections 1 and 2 made easier 
[*]Hearing ranges of enemies reduced
[*]Objective list can now be toggled on and off (PC: t key) (Xbox and PS4 pads: d-pad right)
[*]Updated pad controls image to be either the Xbox or the PS4 pad depending which one is connected
[*]Health Bars above enemies (scaled to represent relative health)
[*]Health Bars above players
[*]Added Volume slider to Options menu 
[*]Health packs spawned on timer
[*]A health pack will spawn again when a player has been revived on a delay if level has been replayed more than 2 times
[*]A donut pickup will spawn again when the last donut has been picked up after a delay if level has been replayed more than 2 times
[*]Downed partners are clearly marked
[*]Updated Cutscene VO audio 
[*]Many Bug fixes 
[/list]

Your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/discussions/]feedback in the forums[/url] has been awesome, so keep it coming. You can find a thread where you can give feedback on this update [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/discussions/0/611702631208677446/]here[/url].

We've also added the game's soundtrack as additional free content for everyone who has bought the game. You can find it in the same folder that LA Cops is installed to on your device!

You should also check out [url=http://twitter.com/lacopsgame]LA Cops on Twitter[/url] to take part in regular competitions, and get the latest on the game!

Keep fighting the good fight,

Modern Dream & MT17

[b]Like this update? Give it a thumbs up using the buttons below, it helps us to get the game on all the best places in Steam![/b]

notes.title: LA Cops is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img=http://thebuttonexperiment.com/LACops/index_htm_files/483.png]
[h1][b]Cops![/b][/h1]

Your time has come. Dunk your DoDo, lock and load your crime fighting weapons and prepare to kick some criminal scumbag butt - LA Cops 1.0 is out now!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/278810

Today's update brings the game to its full release version. You'll find 5 new levels to tackle, plus a myriad of bug fixes and polish to the game based on your feedback in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/discussions/]forums[/url]. 

This is a perfect opportunity for everyone at Team17 and Modern Dream to thank our [b]Amazing Early Access community[/b], who've helped us bring LA Cops from early alpha to full release product. Here's a quick message from Modern Dream's Ollie Clarke, just for you:

[quote=Ollie Clarke]
We're very happy to be able to return the good will that the Early Access players have shown us with their hard earned money by releasing the full game today. 

May we say a huge heartfelt thank you for all your support, feedback and help in making LA Cops the game it is today. Its made the difference. 
This is by no means the end however, we're going to be listening to your feedback post launch and updating the game over the next weeks and months. So keep an eye on us, we've got more to come!
[/quote]

For everyone new to LA Cops, welcome to the force. Watch our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i83OTJmXPVY&list=PLjkadU1Gs-CHjirqLVsNRfIQ91XZf-kh7&index=1]Getting Started vid[/url] for some quick tips on getting started in your crime fighting career, or check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/discussions/]forums[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/videos]Community Videos[/url] sections of the Community Hub for tips from veterans in the force. 

From everyone at Modern Dream and Team17 - enjoy playing LA Cops! We can't wait to see you demolish our scores on the leaderboards.

MT17

[b]Like this update? Hit the thumbs up button below, it helps get onto all the cool places in Steam![/b]

notes.title: LA Cops: Update 4 - NEW LEVEL! NIGHTMARE MODE! 25% OFF SALE!
notes.content:
[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/B4VbA6fIEAE_bPb.png:large]

Listen up cops!

LA Cops is on sale with 25% off between 8th December and 14th December. Grab the discount here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/278810

The 4th update for LA Cops is available to download right now and it's packing some serious heat. I need you in there now, before the Chief puts himself on my back...

[h1]NEW LEVEL! - Warehouse[/h1]
Hostage situations call for a certain level of "moderation". You'll want to avoid the explosives on this one, which makes the fact that we've chucked in a few explosive barrels all the more dangerous. Oh, and be warned, the bad guys have backup.

[h1]NEW CUTSCENE![/h1]
What is Teddy Green [i]really[/i] up to?

[h1]HARDCORE MODE![/h1]
Oh, so you think you're a big shot now? Hardcore makes the bad guys badder. They'll be harder to take down and react much faster. Should still be a cakewalk for an experienced cop like you.

[h1]NIGHTMARE MODE![/h1]
Oh, so you think you're a REAL BIG SHOT now?

Nightmare mode will make you cry. You have been warned. [url=https://twitter.com/LACopsGame/status/541945370549714946]Here's our attempt at level 2, for example.[/url]

[h1]FIXES![/h1]
If you reported it in our forums, it's probably fixed. Found a new bug for us to tackle? [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/discussions/]Report it in the forum.[/url]

As part and parcel of the changes made in this update, save data created before this update will no longer load. In short, you'll have to start from scratch. We hate doing this and know that it may frustrate players - the changes above required a change to the way the game saves data, and we hope you'll understand that it's for the greater good!

That's your lot for now, cops. Get out there and clean those streets.

MT17

[url=https://twitter.com/LACopsGame/]Follow LA Cops on Twitter[/url] for competitions, news and more!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/278810]Add LA Cops to your Steam Wishlist[/url].

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278810/discussions/0/617321352344858223/]Click here to discuss this update in the forums.[/url]

[b]Like this news? Give it a thumbs up using the buttons below, it helps us get the word out about LA Cops! <3[/b]

notes.title: Update No3 Released
notes.content:
Hot on the heels of update No2 we're happy to say that a Update No3 is now available for you to download and play as of sending this email.
This is more of a point update and as such it includes improvements to many of the systems and features in the game whilst addressing bugs and issues as we've found them.
We cant thank you, the community, enough for all your help in telling us what is and isnt working in the game. Its been invaluable and we really appreciate your support. 

Amongst other improvements here's a list of the changes made in this update:
[list]
[*]Added VO for Katsuo, Green and Kowalski.
[*]Doors improvement.
[*]Enemy knock down.
[*]Improved joypad trigger fire on PC.
[*]Crosshair hidden during melee.
[*]Fixed dropped weapons highlight not visible.
[*]Fixed double triggering of objective complete / mission or area complete effect.
[*]Fixed player attributes summary UI on player selection screen.
[*]Fixed menus not working with joypad.
[*]Fixed rotation when player becomes AI.
[*]Fixed tutorial not working with joypad.
[*]Updated attributes screen UI: XP deducted from one counter, fixed text scale.
[*]Build optimisations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update No2 Released!
notes.content:
Update No2 for LA Cops is now available on Steam Early Access

Hi Everyone, hope you're all ready for the weekend!

We've had lots of excellent feedback on the game from players, reviewers and professional testers and we've been working exceptionally hard to deliver a big update for LA Cops. 
When is it available today! If you have LA Cops installed and restart Steam you should find it downloads automatically. 

Amongst the many features we've been working on the main additions are as follows:
[list]
[*]Summon Cop Feature
With a click of the middle mouse button your partner will move to where you have your cursor. This is great for busting in a room with both cops at the same time and taking out thugs in a blaze of gunfighting glory!

[*]Tutorial Level
This level is an introduction to the game and how to play
[*]Lvl3 - Bauhaus
Save wealthy Tycoon - Max Thrace from a gang on thugs intent on stealing his fortune. Unfortunately for Max, he's broke. Better get in there and save his neck! 
[*]Lvl4 - Mansion
A drugs bust operation set in a burnt out Mansion

[*]Cop Voice Overs
We have the first batch of in game Cop VO for Murphy, Borland and Williams implemented. They're sassy one liners will put those criminals in line!
[*]Enemy VO
Enemies react with dumb one liners about how they're going to do you in. Prove them wrong with a bullet or two. 
[*]Cutscenes 4&5
The in game soap opera story is beginning to take form. Will Kowalski come to terms with working with Murphy? And what is Teddy Green up to that has Katsuo so concerned? 
[*]UI Overhaul
[/list]
As well as the above we've made another pass on the User Interface to make it more intuitive and responsive. Please note we're aware of the issues with the joypad interactions in the main menu and the tutorial level and are preparing a fix for them to be released real soon. 
Plus a miriad of polish and fixes to improve the gameplay which is simply too long to list here. The done list we keep track of is many screens long.

We hope you'll enjoy the update this weekend and do keep sending us your feedback. 
Your insights really are making a difference to the quality of the game and we hope you can see us listening, acting on and implementing your ideas in each game update. 
There's lots more content, features and news to come so please keep helping us spread the word, till next time. 

Have a great weekend!
The LA Cops Team.

Update No2 for LA Cops is now available on Steam Early Access

Hi Everyone, hope you're all ready for the weekend!

We've had lots of excellent feedback on the game from players, reviewers and professional testers and we've been working exceptionally hard to deliver a big update for LA Cops. 
When is it available today! If you have LA Cops installed and restart Steam you should find it downloads automatically. 

Amongst the many features we've been working on the main additions are as follows:
[list]
[*]Summon Cop Feature
With a click of the middle mouse button your partner will move to where you have your cursor. This is great for busting in a room with both cops at the same time and taking out thugs in a blaze of gunfighting glory!

[*]Tutorial Level
This level is an introduction to the game and how to play
[*]Lvl3 - Bauhaus
Save wealthy Tycoon - Max Thrace from a gang on thugs intent on stealing his fortune. Unfortunately for Max, he's broke. Better get in there and save his neck! 
[*]Lvl4 - Mansion
A drugs bust operation set in a burnt out Mansion

[*]Cop Voice Overs
We have the first batch of in game Cop VO for Murphy, Borland and Williams implemented. They're sassy one liners will put those criminals in line!
[*]Enemy VO
Enemies react with dumb one liners about how they're going to do you in. Prove them wrong with a bullet or two. 
[*]Cutscenes 4&5
The in game soap opera story is beginning to take form. Will Kowalski come to terms with working with Murphy? And what is Teddy Green up to that has Katsuo so concerned? 
[*]UI Overhaul
[/list]
As well as the above we've made another pass on the User Interface to make it more intuitive and responsive. Please note we're aware of the issues with the joypad interactions in the main menu and the tutorial level and are preparing a fix for them to be released real soon. 
Plus a miriad of polish and fixes to improve the gameplay which is simply too long to list here. The done list we keep track of is many screens long.

We hope you'll enjoy the update this weekend and do keep sending us your feedback. 
Your insights really are making a difference to the quality of the game and we hope you can see us listening, acting on and implementing your ideas in each game update. 
There's lots more content, features and news to come so please keep helping us spread the word, till next time. 

Have a great weekend!
The LA Cops Team.
